## Real hardware (renderer-keyed baselines)

Stroke pipeline through the buffer pool, 1e6 segments per frame as ten 100k-segment ranges (ten draw calls), 1600x1000 css px at dpr 2, 60 s of rAF frames after a 3 s warm-up. Each row comes from the result file named in its last column; the pixel hash of the fixed snapshot scene is stored per renderer in `bench/baselines/renderer-baselines.json`. The CPU column is JavaScript submit time per frame; the GPU column is the timer-query time where the engine offers one. A 120 Hz display makes the frame interval 8.3 ms, so the interval is capped by the display, not by the work.
